title: Zero Hour
paragraphs: A 1970s mystery and suspense anthology hosted by Rod Serling, presenting both standalone dramas and serialized stories spread across a week of broadcasts.

1973-74 suspense anthology hosted by Rod Serling. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 89 broadcasts from December 17, 1973 through July 26, 1974: 65 chapters in thirteen five-part serials plus 24 standalone half-hours.
GRH documents the program through Five-part serial era (September 3, 1973 to April 26, 1974) and Standalone anthology era (April 29, 1974 to July 26, 1974).
Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include death and mortal threat, murder and violent crime, and witnesses and testimony.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including 1970s commercial radio-drama revival and Five-day serial scheduling experiment.
